senses.gloss: ch. same, the act of libation; (in Targ. Y. also) the liquid used for libation.
units: <cite ref="Onkelos Numbers 4:7">Ib. IV, 7</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נִיסּוּכִין</he>, <he>נִיסּוּכַיָּא</he>, <cite ref="N00703"><he>נִסּ׳</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 15:13">Targ. Y. ib. XV, 13</cite> (not <he>נְסוּכְיָיא</he>); a. fr.—V. <cite ref="N00950"><he>נִסְכָּא</he> I</cite>.
